$description: Single source for the app's color and glow tokens. scripts/gen-tokens.mjs (npm run tokens) writes the theme.extend.colors and theme.extend.boxShadow blocks of tailwind.config.ts and the :root block of assets/css/main.css from this file. Keys are the code's token names: color `x` is the Tailwind class suffix (text-x, bg-x, border-x) and the CSS custom property --x. Contrast ratios are not stored here; checks/contrast.mjs computes them and DESIGN_SYSTEM.md records the result.

bg.description: Root studio canvas, gutter backdrop, editor canvas. The ground every contrast ratio is measured against.

surface2.description: Inputs, secondary buttons, section header strip

surface3.description: Hover fill, active tab, metadata pill, scrollbar thumb

border2.description: Focus/active boundary, scrollbar thumb hover, decorative separator glyphs

acid.description: Primary accent: action prompts, active tab, section index pill, XML tag identifiers

acid-dim.description: Low-intensity acid for tinted fills (defined, currently unused)

miku.description: Variable interpolation highlights, term bank badges, compiler tabs

pink.description: Destructive and remove affordances on hover

green.description: Verification success, cost estimate, copy confirmation

text.description: Primary body copy, editor text, headings

muted.description: De-emphasized metadata: token counts, timestamps, placeholders, inactive tabs. Raised from #54607a (3.17:1) to clear 4.5:1 on bg; stays dimmer than muted2.

muted2.description: Secondary labels one step brighter than muted

glow-acid.description: Glow around acid buttons and the section index pill

glow-miku.description: Glow around the active variable-matrix toggle
